_comment: Content for the one-click demo button. Neel owns this file. Everything here is FICTIONAL: the persona, the school and every entry are invented, and the UI must say so on screen. The entries use the exact Entry shape from backend/app/schemas.py so the app can load them as an already-approved timeline. live_message is the sentence the judge sends themselves: it has two honest readings, so the app shows the clarification question, which is the centrepiece of the demo. Nothing here should trigger the safety check except where noted.

persona.name: Amara
persona.label_on_screen: Amara is a made-up example. No real child is shown.
persona.background_en: Amara moved to Germany from Lagos three months ago. She speaks English and is learning German. She goes to a school in Bavaria and has not told anyone what is happening.

timeline.text_child: They laughed at me when I said my name in class.
timeline.text_de: Sie haben mich ausgelacht, als ich in der Klasse meinen Namen gesagt habe.

timeline.text_child: Nobody wants to sit next to me at lunch. They always leave me out.
timeline.text_de: Beim Mittagessen will niemand neben mir sitzen. Sie schließen mich immer aus.

timeline.text_child: Two boys took my bag and threw my books in the bin.
timeline.text_de: Zwei Jungs haben meine Tasche genommen und meine Bücher in den Mülleimer geworfen.

timeline.text_child: They made a group chat about me and wrote that I smell.
timeline.text_de: Sie haben einen Gruppenchat über mich gemacht und geschrieben, dass ich stinke.

timeline.text_child: The same boys made me give them my money and said not to tell.
timeline.text_de: Dieselben Jungs haben mich gezwungen, ihnen mein Geld zu geben, und gesagt, ich soll es niemandem erzählen.

live_message.text: He said he would get me after school.
live_message.why: Two honest readings (a threat, or picking her up). The engine should ask Amara which she meant, with a third option 'something else'. This is the moment the demo exists to show.

handoff.note: Because it happens at school, family is offered too. If where_it_happens were 'home', the app must not suggest family members.
